test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

A hot potato
solution:
The correct answer is **a controversial issue.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The meaning of given idiom is** a controversial issue or situation which is awkward to deal with.**
 
• ***Example:*** The members of the party are not willing to discuss this issue as it is** a hot potato. **
 
• Thus, the most appropriate meaning of '**a hot potato'** is **a controversial issue**. **Option 1** is the correct option.
